definitions.explanation: Thin, noodle-like strips of konjac (konnyaku), a gelatinous food made from the konjac plant. Commonly used in hot pot dishes and simmered dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{糸|いと}こんにゃく⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Put shredded konjac into the sukiyaki.

examples.japanese: {糸|いと}こんにゃく⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧⟦カロリー→カロリー：06109_karorii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Konjac noodles are low in calories and good for dieting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}じゃが→肉じゃが：17620_nikujaga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧とき、{糸|いと}こんにゃく⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{食|た}べ{応|ごた}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: When making nikujaga, adding konjac noodles gives the dish more substance.

notes:
USAGE:
{糸|いと}こんにゃく is a staple ingredient in Japanese home cooking, especially in simmered dishes (⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧) and hot pot dishes (⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧). The name literally means "thread konjac" because of its thin, string-like shape.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {糸|いと}こんにゃく⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (add konjac noodles)
- {糸|いと}こんにゃく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}ゆで→下ゆで：17765_shitayude⟧ (parboiling konjac noodles)
- {糸|いと}こんにゃく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炒|いた}め{煮|に} (stir-fried and simmered konjac noodles)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {糸|いと}こんにゃく: thin noodle-shaped konjac
- ⟦しらたき→しらたき：07480_shirataki⟧: similar thin konjac noodles (more common in eastern Japan)
- ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦こんにゃく→こんにゃく：04931_konnyaku⟧: block konjac (slab form)
